g.text: lamp 0 V: middle strip 6·7·8 → strip 1 terminal 3 (sheet 4)

g.desc: lamp 0 V: middle strip 6·7·8 → strip 1 terminal 3 (sheet 4)

g.text: relays 1–5 break the SF800 pulse lines between the keezer strip and the Uno; D6–D10 use the Uno's internal pull-ups.

g.desc: relays 1–5 break the SF800 pulse lines between the keezer strip and the Uno; D6–D10 use the Uno's internal pull-ups.

g.text: PANP buttons: NO contacts on the lower 8-way strip 5·6·7; C contacts commoned via lower strip 8 → middle strip 1 → 2 → GND (sheet 4).

g.desc: PANP buttons: NO contacts on the lower 8-way strip 5·6·7; C contacts commoned via lower strip 8 → middle strip 1 → 2 → GND (sheet 4).

g.text: low-level trigger: panp.py drives the pin to 0 to power a board. IN1 (IO17) is low only in Pursuit. Cable 0 V returns to the DASH POWER block (sheet 4).

g.desc: low-level trigger: panp.py drives the pin to 0 to power a board. IN1 (IO17) is low only in Pursuit. Cable 0 V returns to the DASH POWER block (sheet 4).

g.text: interlock relay K2 IN (sheet 1); driven by power-relay-rpints.service, not panp.py

g.desc: interlock relay K2 IN (sheet 1); driven by power-relay-rpints.service, not panp.py

g.text: feeds both 2.2 kΩ pull-ups (keezer and lager buses)

g.desc: feeds both 2.2 kΩ pull-ups (keezer and lager buses)

g.text: keezer 0 V tied to the Pi GND at the 3-way block

g.desc: keezer 0 V tied to the Pi GND at the 3-way block

g.text: field side: one 8-core cable into the keezer

g.desc: field side: one 8-core cable into the keezer

g.text: 4: solid brown → message centre C COM

g.desc: 4: solid brown → message centre C COM

g.text: 5: solid orange → speedo B COM → dummy3 F

g.desc: 5: solid orange → speedo B COM → dummy3 F

g.text: 1: solid green → dummy3 E COM → dummy6 G COM

g.desc: 1: solid green → dummy3 E COM → dummy6 G COM

g.text: 7: red → 3 × DS18B20 data, lagering keezer (parasite powered)

g.desc: 7: red → 3 × DS18B20 data, lagering keezer (parasite powered)

g.text: 8: 2.2 kΩ across to 7, from the RaspberryPints Uno 3V3

g.desc: 8: 2.2 kΩ across to 7, from the RaspberryPints Uno 3V3

g.text: pod lamps are inside the pod, lit from the SPEED cable in Pursuit only; USB from the Uno to rpints hub port 1.4

g.desc: pod lamps are inside the pod, lit from the SPEED cable in Pursuit only; USB from the Uno to rpints hub port 1.4

g.text: six serving-keezer probes, via the 3-way block

g.desc: six serving-keezer probes, via the 3-way block

g.text: ttyAMA0 (TXD) carries the dummy bus (E then G), ttyAMA1 (CE0) the tacho. Which shifter channel is which (A6/B6 vs A7/B7) is unconfirmed.

g.desc: ttyAMA0 (TXD) carries the dummy bus (E then G), ttyAMA1 (CE0) the tacho. Which shifter channel is which (A6/B6 vs A7/B7) is unconfirmed.

g.text: Cross-sheet nets are global labels. RPINTS_* nets are the rpints HAT; BREWPI_* nets come from sheet 3; P1_+12V and DASH_POWER_+12V from sheet 1.

g.desc: Cross-sheet nets are global labels. RPINTS_* nets are the rpints HAT; BREWPI_* nets come from sheet 3; P1_+12V and DASH_POWER_+12V from sheet 1.

g.text: Sheet 2 — rpints: PANP buttons and lamps, dash power relays, the flow-meter relays, the serving and lagering keezer sensors, the RaspberryPints Uno, the right switch pod, and the serial buses to the tacho and dummy boards.

g.desc: Sheet 2 — rpints: PANP buttons and lamps, dash power relays, the flow-meter relays, the serving and lagering keezer sensors, the RaspberryPints Uno, the right switch pod, and the serial buses to the tacho and dummy boards.
